name: Gegepterus
sum: Dainty ctenochasmatid from the lower Yixian Formation of Liaoning, China.
holotype: IVPP V 11981 — lower Yixian Formation, near Beipiao, Liaoning.
material: Crushed partial skeleton of a subadult with skull and lower jaws; a second, smaller specimen (IVPP V 11972).
exceptional: Dark soft tissue and hair-like fibres around the head; more extensive pycnofibres in the second specimen.
biology: About 150 needle-like teeth; a filter-feeding or sieving lifestyle like other ctenochasmatids.
author: Wang et al. 2007

species.name: Gegepterus changi
